name: Adding a folder pair with nothing filled in lists what is missing

steps.text: The 'Add folder pair' screen is shown with sections for the folder on this computer, the Google account, the folder on Google Drive, a name, and a sync method
Without choosing anything, click the button at the bottom of the form that continues to the preview
An error list appears that says a folder on this computer, a folder on Google Drive and a name are missing
Click the back button at the top of the screen
The 'Folder pairs' screen is shown again
